text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government to propose solution for the issue of illegal residents at parliament's session next Saturday. About 100,000 stateless people, mostly Arabs, reside in Kuwait.
- Kuwait Investment Company KUIV.KW to market investment fund in Egypt, company official says.
- Syria may open its border with Iraq. The move follows a "successful" visit last week to Baghdad by a group of Syrian businessmen.
- Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) agreed with Kuwait Investments Projects Company KWPJ.KW to sell 12.5 million shares of KIA's stake in United Fisheries of Kuwait.
- Gulf Arab finance and economy ministers meet in Qatar to discuss unifying custom tariffs.
- Kuwait's Acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah received messages from foreign ministers of Egypt and Chile.
- Arab League Secretary-General Esmat Abdel-Meguid says he is willing to visit Baghdad to end POWs' issue. Kuwait says Iraq still detains about 600 Kuwaitis since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
